compliance.summary: The article’s GoGloby section presents the company as a generative-AI implementation and monitoring provider rather than a staffing and recruiting agency. It also includes unverified timelines, product claims, author credentials, and performance metrics that should be corrected or removed.

llm_problems.title: GoGloby positioned as implementer
